subject: Executive Micro-Roundtable — West Coast CFOs: pre-brief & sponsor ask
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@aureuscap.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Executive Micro-Roundtable — West Coast CFOs: pre-brief & sponsor ask

Sarah —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We're putting together a small, invitation-only micro-roundtable for West Coast CFOs in Seattle on the evening of May 19 (dinner + moderated conversation; ~2 hours). Purpose: candid discussion on managing inference cost at scale and emerging vendor strategies — audience limited to 10 CFO/Head-of-Finance-level attendees.

Key details (draft):
- Date / time: Thu, May 19, 6:00–8:30 PM (doors 5:45)
- Venue: High Table (private room) — capacity 14, plated dinner
- Format: 20-min intro from Redwood, 10-min sponsor remarks (Aureus Capital), moderated discussion, open table networking

Would you and your team be comfortable as the evening sponsor (10-minute opening)? We can provide a short slide deck template and a speaker brief. Also, two asks:
1) Can you confirm 1–2 sponsor contacts who will be onsite?
2) All attendees will need to sign Redwood's one-page NDA in advance — we can send a DocuSign link.

Attached draft guest list and venue proposal for logistics. Can you confirm whether Sarah (or someone from events) wants hospitality notes (dietary restrictions, accessibility) captured on our RSVP sheet — we can collect that in the DocuSign flow or as a separate Google form.

Next steps I propose:
- If you confirm sponsorship by Monday (Apr 19), Marcus and I will finalize the venue hold and start the RSVP outreach.
- We will send the NDA via DocuSign and a calendar save once names are confirmed.

Thanks — excited to partner on a tight, high-signal conversation.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: guest-list-draft.csv (stub), venue-proposal-seattle-hightable.pdf (stub)

Thanks for the invite. Aureus Capital would be happy to sponsor and I can do the 10-minute sponsor remarks. I will send a separate note with the speaker name and a headshot by EOD Monday.

Date: 2027-04-12T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Executive Micro-Roundtable — West Coast CFOs: pre-brief & sponsor ask

Soojin / Laura —

Great — thanks to Sarah for confirming. Quick ops notes:

1) NDA: use the one-page mutual NDA we used for last quarter's board dinners (attached in our drive). Send via DocuSign with these fields: name, company, dietary restrictions, guest role. Set signing deadline to Apr 26 to give legal time for review. If Aureus legal requests redlines, route to legal@redwood.ai — allow up to 3 business days.

2) Venue hold: Marcus to confirm provisional hold today with High Table (request private room + AV for a short deck). Budget is $150/head plated; confirm whether Aureus wants branding on place cards.

3) RSVP flow: we'll push the DocuSign as primary capture for signatures and dietary. For guests who prefer not to e-sign, we will accept a signed PDF emailed to events@redwood.ai.

4) Logistics: Laura, please confirm catering menu options (veg, fish, meat, nut-free) and whether High Table can do an isolated prep for nut-free. Also confirm whether valet parking is available for three cars.

I'll loop in legal if any redlines come up.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: redwood-nda-exec-2027.pdf (to be sent via DocuSign), link to internal Drive planning folder

Thanks all —
